bear_case: The bull case for July 6–7 portfolio activation rests on four binary determinations that have NOT all resolved yet: (1) BTC Gate 2 — July 4 UTC midnight close above $62,000 has NOT occurred (though tracking at $62,491 with session low $62,331); a late-session holiday fade is unlikely but not impossible; (2) NVDA Stop Day 2 — July 6 US close above $195 is required; the H200 China 'reopening' is a policy authorization with zero revenue generated, not the revenue catalyst the prior briefs implied; if this distinction reduces the July 6 bullish sentiment around NVDA, the stop may not be isolated; (3) SPCX Day 9 volume — if July 6 (first post-holiday session) sees a surge of delayed distribution volume (sellers who couldn't trade July 3–4 releasing pent-up orders), clearance may push to July 14+; (4) SK Hynix Apple/CXMT — if a contract confirmation is published over the July 4–5 weekend, July 6 KST opens below ₩2,540,000 (new Stop Day 1). The most dangerous scenario is BTC Gate 2 confirming but BTC pulling back sharply at the July 6 US open (first US institutional session) as dollar-denominated selling from holiday-gap positions is released — a 'Gate 2 confirmed but re-entry fails' sequence that traps the first-wave re-entry at $62,500 before a pullback to $60,000–$61,000. IBIT Gate 3 confirmation at July 6 US open is the critical institutional validation before sizing up.
